#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;

    vector<int> c(35, 0);
    int tmp = m, ind = 0;
    bool f = true;
    while (tmp > 0) {
        c[ind] += tmp % w;
        if (c[ind] == w) {
            c[ind] = 0;
            c[ind + 1]++;
        }
        if (c[ind] > 1) {
            if (c[ind] == w - 1) {
                c[ind + 1]++;
            } else {
                f = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        tmp /= w;
        ind++;
    }
    cout << (f ? "YES" : "NO") << "\n";
    return 0;
}
